summary: Verified the two audit-trail bug fixes (PII-redaction false positive + Flip From Here swap wording) end-to-end via 11 pytest API tests (10 pass, 1 xfail documenting a NEW related bug) and full browser-driven UI testing of the real flow: AI confidentiality review -> Apply redactions -> Transcript tab (Speaker View) -> Flip speakers from here -> Save -> Audit Trail. Both fixes work. Regressions (manual rename, direct text edit, split turn persistence, discard, restore backup, reset) all pass. Found 2 issues: (1) Split Turn still produces exactly the original 'nonsense audit entry' the user complained about (index-shift diff garbage + contradictory rename pair) because the edit_note fix was only wired to the flip action; (2) the Audit Trail tab never refetches after edits (only fetches once when auditTrail === null), so a manager who edits and switches to Audit Trail sees a stale list until they click Refresh.

minor.issue: Split Turn (and any save that changes turn count) still yields nonsense audit entries: verified in UI as 'Speaker labels updated: 'Line Manager' -> 'Support Worker'; 'Support Worker' -> 'Line Manager'' PLUS 'Transcript text edited' listing 9 shifted turns, from a single split. Root cause: zip(prev_turns, new_turns) positional diff breaks when turn count changes. The edit_note escape hatch fixes only the flip path. Reproduced by test_11 (xfail) in tests/test_iter90_audit_flip.py.

When edit_note is supplied the auto-inferred rename detail is skipped entirely (elif). If a manager flips AND renames a speaker in the same save, the rename is silently omitted from the audit trail. Consider appending the inferred rename instead of replacing it.

ui_bugs.issue: Audit trail is fetched only once (`if (activeTab === 'audit' && auditTrail === null) fetchAuditTrail()`, line ~156). After saving speaker labels / text edits and switching to the Audit Trail tab, the new entries are NOT shown until the user clicks Refresh or reloads. Confirmed: backend had 3 new entries while the UI list still showed the old 5. This directly undermines the very flow being fixed (manager edits, then checks the audit trail).

issues: The U+2194 swap glyph renders as a small dash-like mark in the headless/limited-font environment ('Manager' -- 'Staff'); text content is correct (verified U+2194 via DOM inner_text). Consider a text fallback like "swapped with" for font-safety.

action_items: Extend the audit-detail fix to Split Turn (and any turn-count-changing save): either push a pendingEditNotes entry from handleSplitTurn (e.g. "Turn N split into two") or make the backend diff index-aware so shifted turns are not reported as text edits/renames.
Make the Audit Trail tab refetch on tab activation (or invalidate auditTrail after a successful speaker-text/text save) so managers see their own edits without clicking Refresh.
Consider logging both the edit_note and any genuine speaker rename in the same save (currently mutually exclusive).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/review.py update_speaker_text: the positional zip() diff is inherently unsafe when turn counts differ (split/merge/delete). The edit_note workaround masks it only for the flip path — recommend a proper alignment (difflib.SequenceMatcher) or an explicit client-supplied change descriptor for all mutating transcript actions.
routers/review.py is 2389 lines — well above the 700-line guideline; the transcript/speaker-text + PII-review sections are natural split candidates.

The read-time-only redaction architecture is still the underlying hazard: any other future diff/compare against transcripts.speaker_text must remember to normalise with pii_redactions first. Consider a single shared helper (e.g. get_effective_speaker_text(meeting)) so callers cannot forget.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 pass, 1 xfail documenting known split-turn bug)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (all target flows pass; 1 stale-data UI bug)

UI recipe that works: get cookies via `python backend/tests/get_tokens.py manager@supervision.com 'Manager123!'`, add supervision_access/supervision_refresh cookies for domain evidence-link-4.preview.emergentagent.com, goto /meetings/{id}/report. Note the turn menu opens by clicking [data-testid=speaker-pill-{i}] (onMouseDown) — NOT turn-menu-{i}, which is the popup container. Audit trail list is newest-first; the tab caches its first fetch so always click [data-testid=refresh-audit-btn] after an edit.
rca_of_the_issue: Both reported bugs are fixed and confirmed: (1) update_speaker_text now normalises prev_text with the meeting's pii_redactions before diffing, so a completed PII review no longer surfaces as a fabricated 'transcript_text_edited' entry on the next save — verified end-to-end (5 AI-detected redactions applied via the real UI, then a flip save produced NO text-edited entry and no redacted/original names in the audit trail). (2) The frontend now sends a human-readable edit_note for Flip From Here and the backend uses it verbatim, producing "Speakers flipped from Turn 3 onwards: 'Manager' <-> 'Staff'" instead of the contradictory one-way arrow pair. Residual risk: the same positional-diff weakness still produces nonsense entries for Split Turn, which is the most likely source of any further user reports of 'nonsense entries'.
